overview: Matrices ka parenthesization jo scalar multiplications minimize kare.
coreConcept: Matrices ka parenthesization jo scalar multiplications minimize kare.
hinglishExplanation: p x q aur q x r ka product p*q*r multiplications; DP m[i][j] = min over k (m[i][k]+m[k+1][j]+p_{i-1}p_k p_j).
formalDefinition: Matrices ka parenthesization jo scalar multiplications minimize kare.
importantProperties: Cost of (p x q)(q x r) = pqr.
Parenthesization se cost bahut badal sakti hai.
Association order se result same, cost alag.
